title: [AAPS3.0_beta3] NSClient - Cant select local Profile, and can't download NS Profile (was beta2)
body: NSClient but probably also AAPS... I can't select my profile. Error below... And not sure what the "reuse..." string/button is in the below...

comments.body: I changed the DIA to 7 and now I can select it. But it doesn't apply. I tried creating a new manual profile in NS, and NSClient can see it, and select it but I get the same. It doesn't apply.

In v3.0 only local profiles are allowed. 

You can download NS profiles into your local profiles and sync them, but using is only allowed for local profiles.

Perhaps that's the problem ?
@Alamo04 - OK I'll try again. Hopefully that improves #807 and no plot too :)
there is profile functional change. see release notes

Not even to make a local copy like you suggested - is this done through the Profile editor? NS / OpenAPS profile used to be select-able there.
